**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve existing uncommitted dispatch records**

If the next numbered record already exists untracked or staged—for example, a manually prepared record or one retained after an advance commit failed—this unconditionally overwrites it because numbering only considers `HEAD`. If validation or the subsequent build then fails, `remove_uncommitted()` also removes that pre-existing file and its index entry. I reproduced both the overwrite and deletion in a disposable repository. Refuse conflicting existing records, or preserve and restore their original contents and staging state; cleanup should only delete records genuinely created by the current invocation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
